stem.text: A diketo acid is a compound with two ketone groups and one carboxylic acid group.

stem.label: limonene
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of limonene: a cyclohexene ring with a ring C=C and an isopropenyl group (C(=CH2)CH3) on the ring carbon opposite the methyl group.

stem.label: terpinolene
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of terpinolene: a cyclohexene ring with a ring C=C and an isopropylidene group (=C(CH3)2) on the ring carbon opposite the methyl group.

stem.text: Which statements about the reactions of limonene and terpinolene are correct?

items: When reacted with an excess of hydrogen and a nickel catalyst, limonene and terpinolene produce the same compound.
An excess of hot concentrated acidified $\text{KMnO}_4$ reacts with limonene and with terpinolene to form different diketo acids.
The reactions of limonene and terpinolene with an excess of $\text{Br}_2$ produce positional isomers with the same number of chiral carbon atoms.
